India beat New Zealand by four runs via DLS in rain-hit second ODI
11 defeats against India in 2026: NZ register unwanted record after 2nd ODI loss

headline: India Secures Narrow Series Lead Against New Zealand In Second ODI
seoTitle: India Leads New Zealand ODI Series 2-0
metaDescription: India has taken a 2-0 lead in their ODI series against New Zealand following a narrow four-run victory determined by the DLS method in a rainy match.
aiSummaryBullets: India defeated New Zealand by four runs in the second ODI match.
The result was determined by the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method following a rain interruption.
New Zealand recorded their 11th loss against India in 2026 after failing to surpass the target.
aiContextParagraph: The second One Day International match between India and New Zealand concluded with a narrow victory for India, extending their lead in the series to 2-0. New Zealand struggled during their innings, managing only 134 runs against India's pace attack. In response, the Indian batting lineup experienced an initial collapse, but contributions from Shreyas Iyer and KL Rahul helped stabilize the team's position before weather conditions interrupted play. Ultimately, the match was decided by the DLS par score, marking the 11th defeat for New Zealand against India during the 2026 calendar year. Despite the win, the performance of New Zealand's batsmen has drawn attention due to persistent inconsistency throughout the series. The match highlighted the effectiveness of India's bowling unit, specifically noting contributions from Gurnoor Brar and Auqib Nabi in dismantling the opposing side's batting order.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to immediate coverage from multiple sports outlets and the significance of New Zealand setting an unwanted record in 2026.
